tools.name: pulpo_create_catalog_item
tools.description: Create a new custom item in the specified catalog for the current account. Use when the account needs to add its own types, statuses, or classifications not in system catalogs. name (max 100 chars) and description (max 200 chars) are required. behavior only applies to vehicles-status: "operable" or "inoperable" — omitting treats the status as inoperable. parentCatalog applies only to: supplier-types, locations-types, movement-keys. customProperties accepts free-form JSON (e.g., for fuel-types: fuelUnitName, isPremium; for tax-types: type, quota). Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

tools.name: pulpo_create_driver
tools.description: Create a new DRIVER. Requires name, email and whether they get app access: ask the user for what is missing. It first looks the driver up by name, email, employee number, license and phone: when someone already matches, nothing is created and it says who. When everyone who matched did so by name only, with another email, and the user says this is another person, otherPersonWithSameName registers them if nobody matches the email, employee number, license or phone. The user type is always Driver with the Fleets service and the default driver role: this tool cannot create administrators or assign other roles. documents takes the refs of the licenses or ID cards read with read_driver_documents, kept in the new driver's documents. accountId and currentUserId are injected automatically from the JWT — do NOT include them. Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). Once they approve, call pulpo_apply_change with the approvalId it returned. Pass language with the user's language for the preview. A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

tools.name: pulpo_assign_driver
tools.description: Assign a DRIVER to a vehicle, extend the current assignment of that driver, or replace the vehicle's driver. It finds the vehicle (Pulpo ID, plate, VIN or economic number) and the driver (userId from a lookup, or name, email, employee number, license or phone), and checks what the assignment changes: when the vehicle already has a driver in that period it asks whether to add or replace, and when the driver has another vehicle it asks whether they keep it; then it proposes the assignment with every change it makes (assignments that end, segments synced between drivers and vehicles, tasks that move to the driver) for the user to confirm. A driver who is not in Pulpo is registered first with create_driver. Only drivers, never administrators. An assignment that starts later is saved but does not solve today's pending item. When it returns a proposal with an effectsKey, call it again with that key only after the user says yes to that proposal. Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). Once they approve, call pulpo_apply_change with the approvalId it returned. Pass language with the user's language for the preview. A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

tools.name: pulpo_list_vehicles
tools.description: List fleet vehicles with optional pagination, text search, and advanced filters. Use the "filters" field for complex queries such as filtering by status, brand, type, assigned driver, insurance expiry, etc. Vehicles missing plate, VIN, brand, model or year (and how many) are get_fleet_basic_data_pending, not this tool. SEGMENT SCOPE: By default, the API returns only vehicles from the authenticated user's segments. To retrieve ALL vehicles regardless of segments, include {"all": null} in the filters. ARCHIVED SCOPE: By default, the API returns only NON-archived vehicles. To query archived vehicles, use {"parent":"archived","archived":{"is":true}} in filters. FILTER SHAPE: every condition is {"parent":"<field>","<field>":{"<operator>":<value>}}, and "parent" repeats the field name. Available filter operators: is (exact equality), in (one of several values), contains (partial text / ILIKE), range (between two values), gt/gte (greater than / greater than or equal), lt/lte (less than / less than or equal), empty (is null / unassigned; only {"empty":true}, since {"empty":false} matches the same empty values), not (different from value). PULPO ID: to find a vehicle by its Pulpo ID (e.g. "V-0012", "v12"), use the "pulpoId" field alone — searchText does NOT match it. The response lists vehicles under "vehicles" and the count under "_metadata._total_rows". The search keeps the user segment scope: an empty list means no vehicle with that Pulpo ID among the vehicles this user can see (it may not exist, or belong to a segment outside their access). Filterable fields: name, registrationNumber, economicNumber, serialNumber, model, year, archived (boolean), segments (number[]), createAt (creation date), insuranceEndDate (ISO date), cf_customFieldsData (custom fields). Catalog fields take IDs, never names (look them up with resolve_catalog_id): vehicleStatus (status ID), vehicleType (type ID), fuelType (fuel type ID), brand (brand IDs with "in": one brand name can have several IDs, so take every ID get_vehicles_brands lists under that name). Status, type and brand names are not filterable. Drivers: assignedDriver (driver user ID); vehicles with no driver are {"parent":"hasDriverAssignment","hasDriverAssignment":{"empty":true}}. Example: {"AND":[{"parent":"vehicleStatus","vehicleStatus":{"is":67}},{"parent":"brand","brand":{"in":[933]}}]}

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicles_catalog
tools.description: Get a simplified list of all vehicles in the account (id, name, registrationNumber only). Optimized for populating selectors and autocompletes in other sections (expenses, maintenance, assignments). Not paginated — returns all active vehicles in the account.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicles_registration_numbers
tools.description: Get the lightest vehicle catalog: only ID and license plate (registrationNumber) for each active vehicle. Designed for cases where only the license plate identifier is needed (external reports, integrations, exports). Not paginated — returns all active vehicles.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_change_history
tools.description: Get the paginated history of changes made to a vehicle's data. Each entry shows the modified field, previous value, new value, who made the change, and when. Results are sorted from most recent to oldest by default. Useful for auditing, change control, and discrepancy resolution.

vehicleId.description: Unique numeric ID of the vehicle

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicles_count
tools.description: Get the total count of vehicles registered in the account. Lightweight endpoint for quick metrics on dashboards and control panels. Does not support additional filters. Returns { count: number }.

tools.name: pulpo_export_vehicles
tools.description: Generate and download an export file (Excel or CSV) with fleet vehicle data. The body defines the columns to include and their headers in the exported file. Search and sort filters are passed as query parameters (same filters as list_vehicles). NOTE: The API returns a binary file (xlsx or csv), not JSON. output parameter controls format: "xlsx" (default) or "csv".

name.description: Vehicle field name to include in the export

columnName.description: Column header to display in the exported file

columns.description: List of columns to include in the exported file

q.description: Advanced filters serialized as JSON (same format as list_vehicles)

searchText.description: Free text to filter exported results

orderBy.description: Field to sort exported records by

tools.name: pulpo_export_vehicle_change_history
tools.description: Generate and download an export file with the complete change history of a specific vehicle. The body defines the columns to include and their headers in the exported file. Useful for audits, compliance reports, and documenting change traceability. NOTE: The API returns a binary file (xlsx or csv), not JSON.

vehicleId.description: Unique numeric ID of the vehicle whose history is being exported

name.description: History field name to include in the export

columnName.description: Column header to display in the exported file

columns.description: List of columns to include in the exported file

tools.name: pulpo_delete_vehicles_multiple
tools.description: Permanently delete multiple vehicles in a single operation. This action CANNOT be undone. Each vehicle is processed individually; if any cannot be deleted due to active associated records (open maintenance, pending expenses, active assignments), the error is logged separately without interrupting others. The response details the result for each ID: { results: [{ id, success, error }] }. Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). Once they approve, call pulpo_apply_change with the approvalId it returned. Pass language with the user's language for the preview. A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

ids.description: List of vehicle IDs to permanently delete

language.description: The language the user writes in, for the preview text. Default en.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_properties_catalog
tools.description: Get the catalog of property types for classifying a vehicle's contractual modality. Property types represent the legal relationship between the company and the vehicle (e.g., Owned, Leased, Lease-to-own, Renting). Used when creating or editing vehicles to populate the propertyTypeId selector.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_statuses_catalog
tools.description: Get the catalog of statuses available for fleet vehicles. Statuses represent the current operational situation of the vehicle (e.g., Active, In workshop, Inactive, Retired). Used in vehicle creation, editing, and status changes. Statuses may have special behaviors configured in the account (e.g., driver assignment restrictions). Recommended to cache locally.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_status_history
tools.description: Get the complete history of status changes for a vehicle, sorted from most recent to oldest. Each entry shows the status it was changed to, date, recorded reason, and who performed the action. Useful for operational traceability, audits, and analysis of workshop or downtime. If the vehicle has never had a manual status change, the history may be empty.

vehicleId.description: Unique numeric ID of the vehicle

tools.name: pulpo_update_vehicle_status
tools.description: Update the operational status of a specific vehicle. Standard endpoint for simple status changes: activating, inactivating, or sending to the shop. The change is recorded in the vehicle status history (accessible via get_vehicle_status_history). vehicleStatusId must be a valid catalog ID — use resolve_catalog_id to look it up by name before calling this tool. Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). Once they approve, call pulpo_apply_change with the approvalId it returned. Pass language with the user's language for the preview. A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

id.description: Numeric ID of the vehicle whose status is being changed

vehicleStatusId.description: ID of the new status to assign to the vehicle

lastStatusChangeDate.description: Effective date of status change (ISO 8601). Defaults to current date.

statusChangeReason.description: Reason or description of the status change

language.description: The language the user writes in, for the preview text. Default en.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicles_types
tools.description: Get the full catalog of vehicle types available on the platform. Vehicle types classify the physical category of the asset (e.g., Truck, Sedan, Motorcycle, Trailer). Mandatory when creating a vehicle and used in fleet filters and reports. Catalog is managed by Pulpo and shared across accounts. Recommended to cache locally.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_assignments
tools.description: Get all active and historical assignments for a specific vehicle, with optional filtering by assignment type and validity date. Returns vehicleUser and vehiclePaymentMethod assignment groups. Use assigmentType to filter by type (note: API uses "assigment" with one "n"). Use assigmentDate to see assignments active at a specific point in time.

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID

assigmentType.description: Assignment type to filter (note: one "n" in "assigment" — matches API)

assigmentDate.description: ISO 8601 date to filter assignments active at that moment

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_latest_assignment
tools.description: Get the most recent vehicle-user assignment for a specific vehicle. Useful to know who the current or last assigned driver is. Use assigmentDate to look up the most recent assignment as of a specific date.

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID

assigmentDate.description: ISO 8601 reference date to look up the most recent assignment

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_user_assignment
tools.description: Get the specific assignment between a vehicle and a driver, including date overlap information with other existing assignments. startDate is required to check for overlapping assignments. Use assignmentId to exclude a specific assignment from the overlap check (useful when editing).

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID

startDate.description: Start date to check overlaps (ISO 8601) — required

assignmentId.description: Assignment ID to exclude from overlap check

tools.name: pulpo_get_user_assignments
tools.description: Get all assignments for a specific driver, optionally filtered by validity date. Returns vehicleUser (assigned vehicles) and userPaymentMethod (assigned payment methods) groups.

date.description: ISO 8601 date to filter assignments active at that moment

tools.name: pulpo_create_payment_method_assignment
tools.description: Create an assignment starting from a payment method toward a vehicle or driver. Links a card or payment method to fleet entities. vehicleId is required if userId is not sent, and vice versa — at least one must be provided. Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). Once they approve, call pulpo_apply_change with the approvalId it returned. Pass language with the user's language for the preview. A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID to assign (required if userId not sent)

language.description: The language the user writes in, for the preview text. Default en.

tools.name: pulpo_get_payment_method_assignments
tools.description: Get all assignments linked to a specific payment method. Shows which vehicles (vehiclePaymentMethod) and drivers (userPaymentMethod) have it assigned. Use date to filter only assignments active at a specific point in time.

date.description: ISO 8601 date to filter active assignments

tools.name: pulpo_get_assignments_autocomplete
tools.description: Suggest available entities to assign from a source entity. Useful for autocompleting fields in assignment creation forms — shows only entities assignable in context. date, supplierName, and module are all required query parameters.

date.description: ISO 8601 reference date to check availability

tools.name: pulpo_get_odometer
tools.description: Get the full details of a specific odometer reading by its UUID. Use this as a pre-read before PUT /odometers/:id to get the current state as a baseline. Returns null if the reading does not exist.

id.description: UUID of the odometer reading

tools.name: pulpo_update_odometer
tools.description: Update an existing odometer reading by its UUID. IMPORTANT: Run get_odometer first as a pre-read, use its response as a baseline, and build the PUT body with only the supported fields: vehicleId, km, registrationDate, origin, originInterface, originModule. Do NOT send read-only fields from GET (registrationTime, createdAt, updatedAt, createdByUserId). Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). Once they approve, call pulpo_apply_change with the approvalId it returned. Pass language with the user's language for the preview. A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

id.description: UUID of the odometer reading to update

vehicleId.description: Vehicle identifier (required by DTO)

registrationDate.description: Effective date/time of the updated reading (ISO 8601) — required, resend the current one if unchanged

language.description: The language the user writes in, for the preview text. Default en.

tools.name: pulpo_get_odometers_history
tools.description: List the complete odometer reading history for a vehicle. Returns a history array of full reading objects plus _metadata with total count.

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID to query odometer history

tools.name: pulpo_get_odometers_latest
tools.description: Get the most recent odometer reading for a vehicle. Returns the full reading object including km, registrationDate, origin, and metadata.

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID to query the latest odometer reading

tools.name: pulpo_get_odometer_transaction
tools.description: Get the odometer reading linked to a specific transactional record (odometer or fuel). Useful for tracing the odometer value associated with a fuel transaction or another record.

recordId.description: Transactional record identifier (odometer or fuel record)

tools.name: pulpo_validate_odometer
tools.description: Validate an odometer reading against business rules before creating or updating. Returns no body on success (validation passes). Returns 400 or 409 with error details if validation fails (e.g., value lower than previous reading, future date). Use this before create_odometer or update_odometer to catch errors early.

vehicleId.description: Associated vehicle ID

registrationDate.description: Effective date/time to validate temporal rules (ISO 8601)

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_fleet_health
tools.description: Validate and get the health findings of a specific vehicle in real time. Runs all enabled health checks at query time for a single vehicle, ensuring updated results. Returns vehicle info plus a discoveries array indicating current issues. Use this when you need to check the health status of an individual vehicle. Possible discovery values: VEHICLES_IN_INOPERABLE_STATUSES, VEHICLES_WITHOUT_ASSIGNED_DRIVERS, VEHICLES_WITHOUT_RECENT_ODOMETER, VEHICLES_WITH_NEAR_ASSIGNMENT_EXPIRATION, VEHICLES_WITH_NEAR_INSURANCE_EXPIRATION, VEHICLES_WITHOUT_INSURANCE, VEHICLES_WITH_INSURANCE_EXPIRED.

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID to validate health findings

tools.name: pulpo_get_fleet_score
tools.description: The fleet's score in Salud de flota (fleet health), as its header shows it: a whole number from 0 to 100, the average of the vehicles the user can see. fleetScore is null when no vehicle is scored yet. vehiclesEvaluated are the scored vehicles the average covers, out of vehiclesTotal.

tools.name: pulpo_get_fleet_basic_data_pending
tools.description: What the fleet still lacks in the Vehicle column of Salud de flota (fleet health): how many of the vehicles the user can see have no plate (registrationNumber), VIN (serialNumber), brand, model or year, with the same rules as the score, and how many are "En Alta" with neither plate nor VIN (emptyInRegistration: empty records created to be filled). Also returns a page of those vehicles, the ones missing the most fields first (they raise the score the most): filter it with only. Each of the 5 fields is worth 4 points of the vehicle score. Counts are limited to the segments the user can see.

only.description: List only the vehicles missing this field, or the empty "En Alta" ones. Omit for every vehicle with something pending.

skip.description: Vehicles to skip, for the next page. Default 0.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_score
tools.description: One vehicle's score in Salud de flota (fleet health), 0 to 100, with the points it still lacks per column (vehicle basic data, circulationPermit, insurance, driver, property, telemetry: field → points), plus the fleet score for context. Identify the vehicle as the user does: Pulpo ID (e.g. "V-0012") or plate; a VIN or an economic number also work.

vehicle.description: The vehicle: its Pulpo ID (e.g. "V-0012") or its plate. A VIN or an economic number also work; a name does not.

tools.name: pulpo_read_vehicle_ownership_documents
tools.description: The lease contracts, purchase invoices and titles already stored with a vehicle (its documents), and what they say: the kind of document, the issuer, its validity, how it says the vehicle is held (ownership: RENTING, LEASING, LEASE when a lease contract does not say which, PURCHASE), the property types of the account catalog that match it (propertyTypes: one, or the ones to ask about) and the contract data it holds. To set one, pass its name as propertyType to update_vehicle_basic_data. Use it when the user asks what a stored document says, typically before deciding whether to change the property type that update_vehicle_basic_data reported storedDocuments for. It reads the documents named by document, or the 3 newest; the others are only listed. Nothing is written. A document classified as an invoice may be another invoice (an inspection, a repair): say what it says, not what its kind suggests. Identify the vehicle as the user does: Pulpo ID (e.g. "V-0012") or plate; a VIN or an economic number also work.

vehicle.description: The vehicle: its Pulpo ID (e.g. "V-0012") or its plate. A VIN or an economic number also work; a name does not.

document.description: Part of the name of the document to read, as listed (e.g. "renting"). Without it, the 3 newest are read

tools.name: pulpo_get_fleet_health_enabled_findings
tools.description: Get the current configuration of which fleet health finding types are enabled for the account. Each boolean property indicates whether that detection type is active. Check this before interpreting results from get_fleet_health or get_vehicle_fleet_health to know which validations are enabled. Finding types: nonOperableStatuses, withoutAssignedDrivers, withoutRecentOdometer, withNearAssignmentExpiration, withNearInsuranceExpiration, withoutInsurance, withInsuranceExpired.

tools.name: pulpo_update_fleet_health_enabled_findings
tools.description: Update the enabled findings configuration for the account, enabling or disabling each fleet issue detection type. Only the fields included in the body are modified; omitted fields keep their current value. Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). Once they approve, call pulpo_apply_change with the approvalId it returned. Pass language with the user's language for the preview. A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

nonOperableStatuses.description: Enable/disable detection of vehicles in non-operable statuses

withoutAssignedDrivers.description: Enable/disable detection of vehicles without an assigned driver

withoutRecentOdometer.description: Enable/disable detection of vehicles without recent odometer readings

withNearAssignmentExpiration.description: Enable/disable detection of vehicles with an assignment nearing expiration

withNearInsuranceExpiration.description: Enable/disable detection of vehicles with insurance nearing expiration

withoutInsurance.description: Enable/disable detection of vehicles without registered insurance

withInsuranceExpired.description: Enable/disable detection of vehicles with expired insurance

language.description: The language the user writes in, for the preview text. Default en.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_insurance_detail
tools.description: Get the full details of a specific insurance policy associated with a vehicle. Returns all policy fields including supplier object, insuranceType object, dates, amount, currency, and isCurrent flag. Query this before a PATCH update to know the current state of all fields. Returns 404 if the policy does not belong to the specified vehicle.

vehicleId.description: Unique numeric ID of the vehicle

id.description: Unique numeric ID of the insurance policy

tools.name: pulpo_update_vehicle_insurance
tools.description: Partially update an existing insurance policy for a vehicle (PATCH — only sent fields are modified). If the updated policy is the current one (isCurrent: true), changes are automatically propagated to vehicle details. Useful for correcting dates, amounts, or policy number without resending all fields. typeId must be a valid catalog ID — use resolve_catalog_id to look it up by name before calling this tool. Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview built by Pulpo (current → new values, and whether it can be undone) for the user to approve (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise in the chat). Once they approve, call pulpo_apply_change with the approvalId it returned. Pass language with the user's language for the preview. A change that can be undone is undone later with pulpo_undo_change.

vehicleId.description: Unique numeric ID of the vehicle

id.description: Unique numeric ID of the policy to update

supplierId.description: Insurance supplier ID (must exist in supplier catalog)

typeId.description: Insurance type catalog ID — resolve it with resolve_catalog_id

policyNumber.description: Policy number issued by the insurer

taxType.description: Whether tax is a percentage or a fixed amount

tax.description: Tax value (percentage or amount, depending on taxType)

language.description: The language the user writes in, for the preview text. Default en.

tools.name: pulpo_get_vehicle_catalog_items
tools.description: Retrieve catalog items for the specified catalog class. Returns both global (system-wide) and custom (account-level) items. Global items hidden by the account are returned with isActive=false. For vehicles-status, items may include a behavior field ("operable" or "inoperable") used by Fleet Health. Available className values: vehicles-status, vehicles-types, vehicles-brands, properties-types, fuel-types, insurance-types, expenses-types, license-types, supplier-types, payment-methods-types, payment-methods-status, users-status, service-types, and more.

tools.name: pulpo_apply_change
tools.description: Runs a change the user approved: pass exactly the values a write tool returned (approvalId, tool, rows, change and, for money, total and currency), only after the user approved that preview (in Pulpo's approval card when the client shows one, otherwise with a plain yes in the chat). It runs exactly what the user approved, once, in the account it was proposed in, and only while the records are still as the preview showed. If the approval is not approved yet, was declined, expired, was already used or belongs to another account, nothing changes and the answer says why.

approvalId.description: approvalId from the write tool result

tool.description: The write tool that proposed it, as the result says

rows.description: Row count, as the result says

total.description: Total amount, only when the result gives one

currency.description: Currency, only when the result gives one

change.description: The change in one line, exactly as the result gives it: the client shows it to the user

tools.name: pulpo_list_my_changes
tools.description: List the changes this user made in the selected account through Pulpo's assistant tools, newest first (90 days): what changed, current → new as it was approved, when, how it ended, and whether it can be undone (with the changeId for pulpo_undo_change) or why not. Changes made in the Pulpo app are not here.

language.description: The language the user writes in, for the preview text. Default en.

tools.name: pulpo_undo_change
tools.description: Proposes undoing one change from pulpo_list_my_changes: restoring the values it replaced, removing what it created, or moving back the money it moved while it is still there. Changes nothing by itself: it returns a preview to approve like any write, then pulpo_apply_change. It refuses, and says why, when the record changed since or the change has no undo.

language.description: The language the user writes in, for the preview text. Default en.
